title: SSH hosts
description: Connects to a server you named in your SSH config, in a new terminal window, without typing the ssh command.
examples: Type omar: omarchy with its user and address; Return opens ssh omarchy in Ghostty
Cmd+K on a host: copy ssh omarchy, or open the config file it came from
